annotations.title: Solana priority fees & Jito tip floor

description: Fetch live Solana compute-unit priority fees and Jito bundle tip floors refreshed every 10 seconds. Takes no required parameters (optional `session_token` after free try). Returns `slot`, `congestion_level`, `priority_fee_microlamports` (`p50`, `p75`, `p95`), and `jito_tip_floor`. Do not use for EVM gas fees (use get_evm_gas_price) or raw RPC queries (use call_chain_rpc). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.001 USDC).

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.
